form.label: Ops overview
form.description: The heavy dashboard a browser run opens: eight panels across the search classes, dense aggregation over web access logs, sparse filters over authentication failures and CloudTrail errors, a rare CloudTrail term that on SmartStore is the panel most likely to pay for an object-storage fetch, and one transaction, which is the first thing to degrade when a search head is under concurrency pressure. Regulator pins the index and the time range through the URL.

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype=access_combined | timechart span=5m count by status limit=10
index=$index$ sourcetype=access_combined | stats count, sum(bytes) as bytes by uri_path | sort - count | head 20
index=$index$ sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | rex "from (?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | stats count, dc(user) as users by src_ip | sort - count | head 20
index=$index$ sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail errorCode=* | stats count by errorCode, eventName | sort - count | head 20
index=$index$ sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail eventName=PutBucketPolicy | table _time, eventName, sourceIPAddress, awsRegion
index=$index$ sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail | timechart span=5m count by eventName limit=10
index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:apigw status>=500 | stats count by gw, path, status | sort - count | head 20

index=$index$ sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie | transaction JSESSIONID maxspan=30m maxpause=5m | stats count as sessions, avg(duration) as avg_session_s, avg(eventcount) as avg_events | eval avg_session_s=round(avg_session_s, 1), avg_events=round(avg_events, 1)
